subject: Take-home: Product API task — brief, window, and reviewer schedule
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cho <evan.cho@gmail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Take-home: Product API task — brief, window, and reviewer schedule

Hi Evan,

Thanks again for taking the time to speak with us yesterday — enjoyed the conversation. As discussed, attached is the take-home assignment for the Product API engineer role. The deliverable is intentionally small: implement a mini API spec (details in the brief) and a short write-up (2 pages max) about your design tradeoffs.

Key points:
- Deadline: 72 hours from receipt (Monday, Jun 23 23:59 PDT).
- Deliverable: code repo (GitHub link preferred) + a PDF write-up.
- What we’ll evaluate: correctness, clarity of API design, error handling, and testing approach. A grader rubric is attached for transparency.

Attachments: product-api-takehome.pdf (task brief), grader-rubric.xlsx (evaluation matrix).

If anything in the brief is unclear, reply here — Aditya (recruiting) will help with logistics; Ava and I will be the reviewers. Markus is looped in for timeline/decisioning.

Best of luck — we look forward to your submission.

—
Lauren Bishop
Hiring Manager, Product Platform
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@gmail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Take-home: Product API task — brief, window, and reviewer schedule

Hi Lauren (and Aditya),

Thanks — got the brief and rubric. 72 hours works for me. Two quick clarifications: 
1) For the persistence layer, are you fine with a small in-memory DB + tests (no live cloud infra)?
2) Should I include a short README with run instructions and sample curl commands?

I’ll send a GitHub link and PDF write-up before the deadline.

Thanks,
Evan

Subject: Fwd: Take-home: Product API task — candidate confirmation + reviewer scheduling

Team — forwarding Evan’s confirmation. He’s asked the two quick clarifications; I answered inline and cc’d him. Reiterating next steps for reviewers so we’re aligned:

1) Reviewer roles: Ava — primary technical reviewer (implementation + tests). Lauren — API design/edge cases and final hire recommendation. Markus — backup for decision and tie-break on architecture fit.
2) Review window: please review within 24 hours of submission so we can conclude loop by Tue morning.
3) Scheduling: if you want a sync to walk through the submission together, propose two 30-minute slots; otherwise we’ll do independent grading and combine notes.

Availability check (follow-up):
- Ava: can you confirm which of these you prefer for a joint sync if needed? 
   • Tue Jun 23 10:00–10:30 PDT
   • Tue Jun 23 15:00–15:30 PDT

I’ve added the candidate profile to our Greenhouse link: https://greenhouse.io/candidates/evan-cho-8572 and put the artifacts into the hiring Drive folder.

—

> Team — forwarding Evan’s confirmation...

Thanks — I can do an independent review which is probably cleaner. If Evan’s submission looks straightforward, I’m happy to skip the joint sync. Otherwise I can do the Tue 15:00–15:30 PDT slot if needed.

Notes for grading: I’ll focus on correctness, test coverage, and how config/edge cases are handled (rate limits, pagination). Lauren — do you want me to leave comments in the repo (PR) or write a short scorecard in Google Docs? I prefer repo comments + a single-line scorecard in the Drive rubric.

—
